questions.promptEn:
[11-14] 다음 글을 읽고 물음에 답하시오.

Eckels walked into the office of Time Travel. The big sign on the wall said, "ⓐNAME ANY YEAR IN THE PAST. WE TAKE YOU THERE." There was a TV on the wall, and Mr. Keith, the new president, was ⓑon the news.

"How can we help you?" said Mr. Parker, the founder of Time Travel.

"(A) 저는 항상 공룡을 보고 싶었어요. Is it possible?" asked Eckels.

"Sure," said Mr. Parker. "We can take you back to the jungle of 60 million years ago."

"Great," said Eckels. "Can you take me there now?"

"You're lucky. There's a time machine (B) ______ leaves ⓒin 10 minutes," said Mr. Parker.

"This is Travis, your travel guide," he continued. "To stay safe, you must ⓓfollow his instructions."

Inside the time machine, there were two other travelers. Eckels sat down and closed his eyes. He felt the machine moving under his feet. ⓔAfter only a few minutes, the machine stopped.
